tracks.title: Octoberland
tracks.excerpt: Bradford Cox’s first solo album in 15 years is a haunted, autumnal meditation on all forms of decay: bodily, spiritual, political, and sonic.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 这是布拉德福德·考克斯（Bradford Cox）15年来的首张个人专辑，是一首关于各种形式的衰败——身体、精神、政治和声音——的秋日冥想曲，令人萦绕不去。

tracks.title: The thing
tracks.excerpt: The Danish artist achieves a beguiling flow state on her second solo album: a set of future standards full of empty space.
tracks.excerpt_zh: 这位丹麦艺术家在她的第二张个人专辑中实现了一种迷人的流动状态：一套充满空旷空间的未来标准。

tracks.title: Chelsea Bridge
tracks.excerpt: Music for Loving (1955) contains some of Ben Webster’s most sophisticated and elegant work, and the larger arrangements avoid the pitfalls of the “jazz-with-strings” genre. This is none more apparent than when the orchestral bells and whistles step aside, allowing Webster and his band the space to linger in the crestfallen ballads. tracks.title: Trimnopedie
tracks.excerpt: On a recent episode of Vish Khanna's Kreative Kontrol podcast, Douglas McCombs explained that music his his primary social activity. This explains the bassist's extensive resume, which includes Tortoise, Brokeback, BASIC, Black Duck, Eleventh Dream Day, and The Sea and Cake. With Chicago's Yr Knives, he adds yet another group to the mix. On the group's debut, Begin Yr Singing , he joins drummer Qu
tracks.excerpt_zh: 在Vish Khanna的Kreative Kontrol播客最近的一期节目中，Douglas McCombs解释说，音乐是他主要的社交活动。这解释了这位贝斯手丰富的履历，其中包括Tortoise、Brokeback、BASIC、Black Duck、Eleventh Dream Day和The Sea and Cake。随着芝加哥的Yr Knives的加入，他又为自己的履历增添了一个乐队。在乐队的首张专辑《Begin Yr Singing》中，他与鼓手Qu合作。

tracks.title: This is How it Should Be Done
tracks.excerpt: For their collaborative full-length debut, Eris Drew and Octo Octa hunkered down in their New Hampshire cabin to craft a celebratory, sample-heavy tribute to the maximalist dance music of yore.
tracks.excerpt_zh: Eris Drew和Octo Octa在他们的新罕布什尔州小木屋里蹲下，为他们合作的全长首演制作了一个庆祝性的样品，向昔日的极致舞曲致敬。

tracks.excerpt: We all need a hobby. Some people get into fantasy football. Others are obsessed with knitting. There’s cosplay, astronomy, astrology, ham radio … the possibilities are endless. But for my money, the best hobby a guy or gal can have is Bob Dylan. The man just continues to give, even as he cruises through his mid-eighties. The post Bob Dylan :: The Rolling Thunder Revue: The 1976 Live Recordings fir

tracks.excerpt: Birthday girl Ella Mai celebrates turning 32 with the release of the surprise project ‘3two,’ and she is in lovergirl mode on the EP. The post Ella Mai Chooses Love On Surprise EP ‘3two’ appeared first on SoulBounce .
